Dear [Mr Wooldridge](../persons.html#2094)
[Mrs Yonge](../persons.html#1604) comes to Otterbourne Vicarage this afternoon, and will be in the village till some day next week. I think you had better send the papers to me, as I am not certain whether she will be at the Vicarage or the Grange, and I will get her signature[^1]
Please pay the 4/ and add to your account

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: The Vicarage was the home of Frances Yonge\'s daughter Alethea Bowles, and the Grange of their friend [Mrs Jones Bateman](../persons.html#784).
